title: `last-prompt false` — zsh redraws the command line under the list, zshrs draws nothing

observed.notes: With last-prompt off, zsh still repaints the command line on the row below the listing; zshrs leaves that row empty.

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '1 row(s) differ'; failure fingerprint fc1984d85b, unchanged

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
